outcome.technical: tests/test__tree_stamp.py only. The tso block's shape files are now written by _write_shapes(root, write) over SHAPE_NAMES; an OSError on TAB_NAME ('tab\there.txt') is recorded and returned, and an OSError on any other name re-raises. The tab file is also edited after the commit when it exists, so it sits in both the index half and the differing half of the listing (the differing-half partition at _tree_stamp.py:507 was not reached by a tab name before). New cases: tso3 asserts the tab path appears exactly once in the reading's tracked paths and once in its current paths, or, where the filesystem refused the name, reports it by name through _harness.skip ('tso3 ... SKIPPED HERE - this filesystem refused to create a file named ...'); tso4 runs the builder against a writer refusing the tab name with OSError(EINVAL) and asserts every other shape is built and only the tab name is returned; tso5 is the over-fire twin, where a refusal of 'n\u00e4me.txt' must raise. Added `import errno`. Chose the skip-by-name route over a substitute name: the tab is the only byte that tells a split at the entry's first tab from a later one, and every other byte git quotes (control bytes, double quote, backslash) is also unusable in an NTFS name, so no Windows-legal name reaches the same branch. Gate: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__tree_stamp.py` exit 0, 65 cases (was 61). Extra, not gates: `ruff check tests/test__tree_stamp.py` exit 0; `vermin -t=3.8- --no-tips --violations tests/test__tree_stamp.py` exit 0. Windows-name sweep of the P143 additions to tests/test__tree_stamp.py and tests/test__scoped_commit.py (`git diff main..HEAD` added lines grepped for tab/newline escapes, <>:"|?*, \u/\x escapes, trailing dot/space, CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COMn/LPTn, plus every _write/os.path.join/_commit_one/_repo/_unborn name): the tab name is the only Windows-illegal name. Left as is, each legal on NTFS: 'n\u00e4me.txt' (NTFS stores Unicode); test__scoped_commit.py's keep/{b,c,d,first,inside,one,two}.txt, the `HEAD` directory and `head` file (separate unborn repos; the case-folding collision is the case's design), docs/x.txt, docs-old/y.txt, .claude/audit.config.json, .claude/.gitignore, missing.txt (never created), and 'keep/*.txt', which is a pathspec handed to git, never a file created. Dependants: plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_tree_stamp.py unchanged and still correct, now probed by a tab name in both listing halves; tests/test_stamp_verification.py defines its own _seeded_repo/_recorder_dirty_cases/_cases/_git (lines 78, 536) and imports nothing from this file, so unaffected; .github/sweep-costs.json keys this file by path (line 437) and no stage was added or renamed, so its block costing is unchanged. Windows itself not run here; the orchestrator's Windows CI is the verdict for that platform.
outcome.descriptive: The tso block no longer dies on Windows: the tab-named fixture is built only where the filesystem accepts it, and its case says by name when it is skipped.
